summary_en: MP-2606 K.K. launched an MBO to take SHARINGTECHNOLOGY private at 1,550 yen per share over a 30-business-day period from September 10 to October 27, 2026, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 16,030,200 shares. The board endorsed the offer and recommended shareholders to tender, with delisting expected following squeeze-out procedures.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Support for and Recommendation to Tender in the Tender Offer for Our Share Certificates, etc. by MP-2606 K.K.
translation_en_brief:
On September 9, 2026, SHARINGTECHNOLOGY's board of directors expressed support for a tender offer initiated by MP-2606 K.K., a special-purpose company backed by MBK Partners JC V, L.P. (86.93% stake) and Hippo Finance Limited (13.07% stake), and recommended shareholders to tender their shares. The offer targets the delisting and privatization of the company through a series of transactions including a squeeze-out procedure to convert SHARINGTECHNOLOGY into a wholly-owned subsidiary.

The tender offer runs for 30 business days from September 10 to October 27, 2026, with an offer price of 1,550 yen per ordinary share. Warrants issued on August 30, 2024 (the 15th and 16th series of new share purchase rights) will be purchased at 1 yen each, subject to adjustment for the 16th series if performance conditions are met during the offer period. The offer has a minimum acceptance threshold of 16,030,200 shares, representing the number required to achieve the squeeze-out objective. No maximum number of shares has been specified. Following completion of the tender offer and any necessary squeeze-out procedures, the company is expected to be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth market, where it has traded under code 3989.
